name: Qdrant Cloud
short: Managed vector similarity search and embeddings store for RAG, with a permanent free cluster tier and usage-based cloud scaling.

plans.name: Free tier
plans.notes: Single-node cluster: 0.5 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 4 GB disk; no credit card.

plans.name: Cloud (pay-as-you-go)
